Endurance/time-trial studies (PMID27231439, PMID30617467, PMID36678258), sleep trials (PMID22038497, PMID23732552), fibromyalgia pain (Elliot 2010), unresolved cherry-cocoa report (10.59841/an-najat.v3i4.3456), and pending UMIN000057292 do not measure clinical fatigue after dried cherries.

Randomized orange-pomace trial (DOI10.1016/j.jff.2019.103438, NCT02979496) improved stool frequency (p=.0281) and softness (p=.04) outside PD while increasing gas/bloating; separate constipation-severity score unavailable.
Orange-pomace crossover (PMID36102329) found null primary stool-frequency interaction (p=.46) and null no-movement interaction (p=.40) with baseline imbalance.

Older-adult survey (CERES2125) found unadjusted Rome III constipation 31/120 vs 9/19 (p=.054) without raw preparation or adjustment; Lima surveys (Gomez-Rutti n=1144, UPN11537 n=100) omit directional cross-tabs and excluded constipation.

Fox Insight (DOI10.34024/rnc.2025.v33.20260) linked daily pooled fresh fruit with a binary non-daily/missing bowel category without isolating oranges; PD probiotic trial (PMC7774928) used orange flavor in both arms and hospital records (PMID38756536) counted mixed Citrus aurantium decoctions.

Sequential pasteurized OJ was null (PMID30638420), levan-OJ gave juice to both arms (PMID22852055), surgical OJ vs coffee lacked untreated control with registry mismatch (80 vs 476), and Chagas (n=12) and trifoliate-orange (n=25) lacked controls.

Parkinson baseline figure plots an unquantified near-zero inverse sign for unspecified egg frequency and falls with no numeric coefficient, uncertainty interval, poaching distinction, or temporal direction.

Older-adult case-control study (PMID36915191) reports mean weekly egg portions 2.03 in fall-with-fracture cases vs 2.21 in controls (unadjusted p=.07), with no preparation-specific or adjusted fall-frequency estimate.

Nutri-Park compared protein timing groups with no clear fall difference and listed eggs only as an example dinner option; EGGSPDITe, yolk-synthesis trials (PMID32598445), choline challenges, and laboratory abstracts do not measure poached eggs or falls.
Placebo-controlled trial (PMID29163162) reports lower Hamilton anxiety scores with grape fruit extract in healthy older adults with low baseline anxiety and no Parkinson cohort.
Twelve-week randomized trial of whole-grape powder in postmenopausal women (PMC7257957, 40 assigned, 32 completers) reports no clear anxiety difference (numeric contrast omitted).

Acute purple grape juice crossover (PMID28429081) found higher calm ratings with order effects; aquatic-exercise juice family (PMID32798568/33644467) omitted anxiety; NCT07214428 has no posted Hamilton anxiety results.

Dried Corinthian currants reduced rotenone-rat open-field thigmotaxis (p=.006) but not elevated-plus-maze anxiety (p=.929, PMID36613906); A53T mouse grape concentrate center time was null (PMID33207644); isolated resveratrol abstracts do not test raw grapes.

Exploratory randomized trial in healthy adults (PMID39064742) favored boiled waxy barley over rice on POMS 2 tension-anxiety change; final medians were equal (43), foods were unblinded, and eight participants were excluded.
Cooked barley-flour versus rice-flour crossover in 23 adults (10.1093/cdn/nzz044.P08-076-19) found no clear between-phase anxiety difference.

Talbinah (PMID23493965) gave inconclusive DASS anxiety; PMID40336123 fed barley to both arms without an anxiety scale; NutriAct (DRKS00010049) excluded gait-affecting PD; beta-glucan mice and hyperthyroid case do not isolate boiled barley.

Randomized trial in forensic inpatients (PMID25431880, same cohort as PMID24812543) reports lower state anxiety over time with Atlantic salmon vs meat control (p=.043; trait anxiety inconclusive; grilling and boiling pooled).
Randomized oily-fish advice trial with optional fish-oil substitution in men with angina (PMID12608739) gave an adjusted anxiety difference of +0.82 (95% CI -0.57 to 2.22).

FINS-TEENS mixed oily-fish lunches (PMID29056893) showed null overall SDQ emotional change with high-baseline subgroup favoring meat; FISK Junior (PMID32529206) improved broad internalizing (-0.63) without standalone anxiety or salmon isolation.

MVP-2024 plots an unquantified inverse non-fried fish anxiety tile; Fox Insight (PMID36501214) and Lithuanian PD MedDiet (PMID41878573) model whole diets; ALSPAC pregnancy cohort (PMID23874437) grouped oily fish.

Randomized four-arm adolescent conference abstract (DOI10.26911/mid.icph.2018.01.24) reports banana-only arm anxiety regression coefficient -7.84 (p<.001); raw preparation and full methods remain unavailable.
Small randomized healthy-adult trial (DOI10.12691/jfnr-10-12-2, n=20) found no significant between-group tension-anxiety change after Cavendish bananas.

Ambon-banana inpatient study (ijphrd.v11i7.10253) had unclear allocation, varied medications, and baseline imbalance; post-breast-surgery trial (PMID40331125) printed a t statistic conflicting with means, SDs, and group sizes.

Uncontrolled PD personalized nutrition (PMID30278074) offered optional banana-flavored liquid without isolating fruit; case (PMID35802918) and rat juice study (PMID16327247) note levodopa interaction without anxiety scores.
Parkinson baseline figure plots an unquantified inverse tile for unspecified coconut oil and fatigue without numeric estimate, uncertainty, or virgin grade.

KIM MCT-diet trial (NCT05469997) showed 9/37 improved and 9/37 worsened fatigue (inconclusive); Phillips 2018 (PMID30098269) varied whole ketogenic vs low-fat meal plans; PMID38561682 worsened fatigue in both arms; ISRCTN13221188 omits grade and counts.
Chemotherapy virgin coconut oil trial (PMID25163649) had baseline imbalance (49.34 vs 36.38) and non-significant individual timepoint comparisons despite a descriptive trajectory.

FNRI-2007 cyclists (n=15 null exertion), runners with coffee (PMID31330804 p=.99), military ketogenic whole-diet crossover (n=7, optional recipe oil), PACTR201707002406306, and infection trials (PMID38812763, PMID38282651) supply no isolated virgin-oil fatigue effect.

Parkinson baseline graphic plots an unquantified inverse tile without numeric coefficient, CI, or refined grade; earlier/later MVP reports (PMID29081890, PMC9966010, preprints202610.1107.v1) model total PRO-PD without balance isolation.
Multiple-sclerosis trial (PMID36594273) combined extra-virgin coconut oil with EGCG, had baseline Berg imbalance (49 vs 43), and reported within-arm tests only.

PD ketogenic MCT feeding study (PMID38561682) found no clear mobility difference; pooled caregiver reports (10.18103/mra.v12i4.5316) and altered-feed rotenone rats (PMID28373840) do not isolate refined coconut oil.
Parkinson baseline graphic plots an unquantified inverse tile for unspecified coconut oil and sleepiness without grade, adjustment, or uncertainty.
Parkinson ketogenic meal plan naming virgin coconut oil had a 0.45-point descriptive sleepiness item advantage over a low-fat meal plan; whole-diet design cannot isolate the oil.
Caregiver narratives (10.18103/mra.v12i4.5316) pool diagnoses/preparations without standardized scales; ISRCTN13221188 omits Epworth scores and virgin-oil estimates.
Parkinson baseline graphic plots an unquantified weak inverse tile for unspecified coconut oil and motivation/initiative without oil grade, adjustment, or error limits.
PD ketogenic MCT feeding trial (PMID38561682) found no clear between-group diary apathy contrast; KIM (NCT05469997) reported no post-diet apathy comparison.

Baseline graphic plots an unquantified weak inverse tile for unspecified olive oil and self-rated movement slowness; PMID29081890 reports total PRO-PD (-31.4) without isolating bradykinesia or cold-pressed grade.

Mediterranean diet RCT (PMID32319358, n=70) and protein-redistributed menu (PMID21535916) report total UPDRS without isolating cold-pressed olive oil or bradykinesia; Buriram (TCTR20210303005) and PMID40066073 use shared olive-oil cannabinoid vehicles.

Oral olive oil alone in MPTP mice gave unclear pole/rotarod comparisons (PMC10526674), while injected EVOO improved open-field/rotarod (10.1177/2397847320922939) via a non-oral route and non-bradykinesia proxy.

Early-Parkinson observational study (PMID34127758) found non-significant correlations between plasma ALA and body bradykinesia (age-adjusted rho=-.230 p=.171; sex-adjusted rho=-.151 p=.372) without dietary correlation or oil contrast.

Randomized flaxseed omega-3 plus vitamin-E PD trials (PMID28342967, PMID30554092) lacked an oil-only arm and separate bradykinesia score, and found no clear Part III effect (-1.9 vs +3.1, printed p=.05).

Older-adult FAB motor series was null (PMC10056498 p=.140); maternal-separation rat locomotion was null (PMID39374840 p=.595); rotenone open-field activity (ijbcs.20170603.01) and purified ALA models (PMID40269665, PMID40946953) do not measure clinical bradykinesia.
Small human flaxseed-oil trial (DOI10.23937/2474-3631/1510010) found an inconclusive final Beck anxiety comparison (p=.31) with low baseline anxiety, no change interaction, and unverified pressing.
PD flaxseed omega-3 plus vitamin-E trials (PMID28342967, PMID30554092) report aggregate UPDRS/Part I scores without an isolated anxiety item or oil-only comparison.

Maternal-separation rats (PMID39374840) showed mixed EPM vs null light-dark and higher amygdala inflammation; haloperidol poster (SBFIS2024-P259-PAIVA) showed no isolated oil benefit; rotenone mouse EPM (INDJ/2017/34206) is a remote animal proxy.

Registered 3-oil hemodialysis trial (NCT02103556, PMID25238699, n=50) compared flaxseed, olive, and active mineral oil; Rome III fell within all arms with an inconclusive between-oil interaction (p=.15) and no inactive control or verified pressing.

Lipid trial (sjams.2018.v06i01.047) logged 2/57 vs 5/55 constipation adverse events vs active liquid paraffin without severity scores; plasma ALA did not associate with PD Wexner constipation (PMID34127758); solvent-extracted oil in rats (PMID25889554) was nonmonotonic.

Single-blind oral flaxseed-oil osteoarthritis trial (DOI10.36347/sjams.2019.v07i09.031) reports lower rest and movement pain, limited by inconsistent dosing, unverified cold-pressing grade, and non-PD cohort.
Same-group single-blind RA flaxseed-oil report (Vyas-2020-IJHCR-397) reports lower rest/movement pain (p<.001) with numeric inconsistencies and unverified independence from the 2019 report.

Competing randomized trials show null pain contrasts: ACL surgery flaxseed vs corn oil (PMID36398219, KOOS 87.6 vs 87.3, p=.96), RA flax vs linoleic acid (PMID7597378, n=22), and cyclic mastalgia vs vitamin E (PMID33407941, p=.142).

PD flaxseed omega-3 plus vitamin-E trials (PMID28342967, PMID30554092) report total UPDRS without pain items; vitamin-D add-on (PMID42529699) has baseline imbalance and endometriosis report (PMID39759908) conflicts on ethanol extract vs oil.
